During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''Sith''' of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] the [[Unidentified Taerab CEO|CEO]] of [[Taerab Starship Manufacturing]], a company that produced [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnoughts]] for the Empire, prompting Taerab to refuse to build any more ships for the Empire.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Professional Courtesy}}</ref>
